facts.question: Can a depth-1 cell member raise a depth-2 subcaptain?
facts.answer: YES only through a direct startActivation with an explicit absolute request.maxDepth >= 2; the subagent tool path refuses it at the default config

facts.question: Does a host-plane row observe child agents' pre-step / turn-stopping?
facts.answer: YES, payload carries the live agent and pre-step is a waterfall that can inject {kind:'enter', messages}; turn-stopping is serial and cannot veto
evidence: dsh-scope/lib/index.js scopeTarget admits untagged listeners globally

facts.question: Can a host-plane row read live context occupancy for a child?
facts.answer: YES via sessionProjections.stateOf(session, 'contextPressure'); fields are pressureTokens / projectedTokens / contextWindow, never usedTokens; reads take a Session object
evidence: presets/mpd.patch.yml (token meter stays on the host plane)

facts.question: Can a mode-scoped 'captain may only dispatch' guard be installed?
facts.answer: YES through dsh.guardTool(exec => string | undefined); denial is the returned string; exec carries name, arguments and the live agent

facts.question: Can a cell member's own context be compressed, and what happens when nothing is compactable?
facts.answer: YES with the member's own engine compactNow(agent, signal); idle-only; null = no safe range; reseed = dispose + new activation with the handoff text
facts.confidence: high for engine/preconditions, medium for the retire flow

defectsFound.symptom: compactNow(agent, undefined) throws a raw TypeError before the ManualCompactionError classification because signal.throwIfAborted() is the method's first statement
defectsFound.action: Wave 1 fix: pass a real AbortController signal and add a test
